label: Post-hoc safety follow-up; does not replace or alter e4-direct-confirm-v1.
objective: Test a fixed O(r^2) randomized residual guard with precision promotion or exact refresh in the deliberately ill-conditioned near-duplicate-kernel stress test.
authoritative_state_policy: Quantize initial G, M, and every update vector to the declared starting precision, then accumulate authoritative G and M in FP64 from exactly those quantized values. Promotion cannot recover bits absent from the starting-precision stream.

guard.probe_reuse: One fixed rank-by-8 probe matrix per problem seed, paired across operators, deltas, and starting precisions.
guard.evaluation_frequency: After initialization and after every update, before any guard action.
guard.float32_action: Promote L and Aw to FP64 by exact Cholesky factorization and complete rewhitening from authoritative G and M; never demote.
guard.float64_action: Exact FP64 Cholesky factorization and complete rewhitening from authoritative G and M.

diagnostics.exact_residual_frequency: Before and after the guard at every step.
diagnostics.role: Confirmation evaluation only; exact residual is never read by dispatch.

predeclared_scientific_criteria.false_negative_definition: A pre-guard exact residual above the active dtype limit while the probe estimate is at or below the active dtype half-limit.

statistical_unit: One independently generated problem seed; the 101 within-trajectory records are repeated measures.
